newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI bought net $7.8 bln in 96/97 - minister.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI bought net $7.8 bln in 96/97 - minister.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) made a net purchase of $7.8 billion dollars in the 1996/97 (April-March), a minister said.

"The Reserve Bank of India undertakes purchase and sale of foreign exchange from the market with a view to smoothening the short term fluctuations and to maintain orderly market conditions," minister of state in the finance ministry, M.P Veerendra Kumar said in Parliament on Thursday.

"During the financial year 1996/97, total net purchases of US dollars by the Reserve Bank of India in spot, forward and swap segments of the foreign exchange market amounted to $7.8 billion," he said.
